description: This file defines the PublisherRepository interface, which extends Spring Data JPA's JpaRepository to handle CRUD operations for Publisher entities and custom fetch strategies using EntityGraph.

classes.name: PublisherRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for Publisher entities, allowing CRUD operations and custom fetch strategies.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Finds a Publisher by ID, eagerly fetching associated books using EntityGraph.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all Publisher entities, eagerly fetching associated books using EntityGraph.
